comment: A union of one branch per staged source, not a join. fct_too_many_joins counts distinct direct parents (13 on int_pois_unioned, against too_many_joins_threshold 7), and a union of N sources has N parents by construction. The pattern matches today's int_pois_unioned and the int_<mart>__unioned models planned in #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads, where one branch per club puts every union past 7. It must never match a model that joins.

Ends if stage 5 of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads gives reviewed files a staleness rule of their own when it sets the per-cadence thresholds.

Its rows are the var trail_lines_coded_domains, a frozen copy of side_trails' Blaze and Type coded-value domains read from the live layer on 2026-10-02, because no extract lands a layer's field metadata yet: export_trails.py and export_spurs.py fetch the same domains live today (lib/arcgis.get_field_coded_domain). A model with no parent is what that copy is, and reading another model only to have one would hide it. tests/test_dbt_trail_lines_parity.py pins the var to the domains the exporters' own tests decode with. Ends when the extract lands each layer's fields[].domain.codedValues and this model reads that source instead, part of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

One model for both exporters' blaze rules, as the lead set it on 2026-10-02 so the A.T. and the network read one answer: its seven parents are the A.T.'s two staging models and the network's union (one branch each), the network's sources, the reviewed blaze_mapping.json, the coded domains and the registry rows the A.T. reads its blaze_default from. Each is a branch or a lookup, never a second set of rows joined to the first, so the count measures sources rather than joins. Ends if the A.T. half gets a staging union of its own to read, part of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

A step_ exposure is a Python step inside the build, not an outside consumer: pipeline/ELT.md, "Python steps, outside dbt", has each step read a named intermediate and write a derived table dbt reads back, and the exposure on that intermediate is what draws both halves in the docs. Intermediates are protected, and making one public to satisfy this rule would offer it to every consumer. The first is step_dem_sampling, which reads int_elevation__sample_points for the DEM (EL06). ELT.md plans this row, one of the intended two, for #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

step_long_path_guide (pipeline/step_long_path_guide.py, PO36) reads two staging views, stg_nynjtc__long_path_guide and stg_nynjtc__long_path, once per build between dbt invocations. build_marts.py's lane check reads each step's inputs off its step_ exposure and refuses a --lane build for a step with none (lane_problems()), so its exposure must name those views; the rule guards an outside consumer that re-queries a view, which a step reading once is not. The alternative is a pass-through table per view, which adds two models and no rule. Measured 2026-10-02: the evaluator failed this rule on exactly those 2 parents and nothing else. For #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

The points_of_interest mart's versioned nodes (decision 44: dbt 2.0.6 names a version's node points_of_interest.v1, which a pattern naming plain points_of_interest does not match). v1's ten leaves are today's ten phone files, whose shape decision 44 makes v1: eight poi_<type>.geojson files (one per type, because the client builds its download list from that namespace), nearby_poi.geojson and retired_poi.geojson, as export_poi.py, export_nearby_poi.py and export_retired_poi.py write them today. v2's nine are the same files' stage 6 shape (eight v2/poi_<type>.geojson and v2/nearby_poi.geojson, each position once at 6 decimals). Each is one writer per file, filtering the mart to its file and wrapping the rows in the file's envelope; none re-derives a field, which is the duplication fct_model_fanout exists to catch. Lasts while both versions are written, until v1's deprecation_date, under #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

The trail_lines mart's versioned nodes (decision 44: dbt 2.0.6 names a version's node trail_lines.v1, which a pattern naming plain trail_lines does not match). The mart is the one home of every line a phone draws, and decision 24 gives each phone file its own writer: v1's leaves are pub_spurs and pub_trail_miles, which read its A.T. rows, and pub_nearby_trails, which reads its network rows, each the only writer of its file (tests/test_dbt_publish_writers.py). They are one writer per file, not a fan-out to fold into an intermediate, and reading the mart is what holds nearby_trails.geojson to the mart's closure-field tests. v2 has one writer, pub_trail_miles_v2, for stage 6's packed v2/trail_miles.json. Lasts while both versions are written, under #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

One row per source a conditions file is written from, each answered from that source's own input: the notice union, the two landings of ATC's reviewed file, OurHike's public reports, the NWS alerts that landed, the work-projects file and the extract's run log for NYNJTC's count, beside the publication verdict; and, since decision 53's phase C, the registry and seeds/notice_readers.csv for which notice sources get a row, the club notices' own rows for each one's count, and int_closures__notice_tables for whether each one's raw table is in the warehouse at all (decision 61). Each parent is one source's lookup, never a second set of rows joined to the first, so the count measures sources rather than joins. Ends if the files no notice feeds get a gate of their own, part of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

A generated staging model is a union of one branch per base model, not a join: pipeline/make_dbt_staging.py writes one stg_<folder>__<type> per club folder and type, conforming each of the folder's layers to the type's union, and fct_too_many_joins counts each layer's base model as a parent (27 on stg_octa__trail_lines, one per OCTA atlas layer, against too_many_joins_threshold 7). The pattern matches only the generated trail-line staging models, and no staging model joins (decision 40). Ends if a folder's layers get a staging model each, part of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

conditions/notices.json is one union of the two marts' club rows (closures and warnings, each v1, two parents), then lookups by source or by notice, never a second set of rows joined to the first: seeds/notice_readers.csv for which sources are club notices and each one's steward_kind, the registry for its provider and layer title, seeds/notice_hazard_areas.csv for decision 67's hazard, int_closures__nynjtc_checked for NYNJTC's place terms, int_closures__gate for whether a source that may publish is held, base_extract__runs for checked_at, and seeds/notice_states.csv for decision 76's states. Nine parents against too_many_joins_threshold 7 (eight counted from the manifest at 0040d645, then notice_states; nine ref() targets in the model's SQL, read 2026-10-09), so the count measures lookups rather than joins. Ends if the checked_at reads move into an intermediate of their own, part of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

It reads DuckDB's own catalogue (information_schema.tables), which no source() or ref() can name: whether a club notice source's raw table is in this warehouse at all, the question decision 61's hourly warehouse makes (a notices table waiting its turn, one the served copy left out, or a build without the notices). A source() of the table would fail on the very absence it is asking about. Ends if dbt gains a way to ask whether a source's relation exists. Part of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

int_closures__gate reads seeds/notice_readers.csv for which notice sources it answers, and int_closures__notice_tables for whether each one's raw table is in the warehouse: a catalogue answer keyed by the readers' tables, not a second copy of their rows. Kept apart so the gate's unit tests mock the catalogue's answer, where folding it into the gate would read the unit-test warehouse's own catalogue. Ends if the gate stops needing the readers' other columns. Part of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

Declared by hand in staging/gatc/_gatc__sources.yml, because make_dbt_staging.py stages no club_pdf row; its base model reads the absent table as no rows (macros/raw_or_empty.sql), and the extract's own change check is the PDF's validators and sha256. Ends when fixture mode serves the PDF. Part of #669 — The maintaining clubs publish PDFs nothing fetches, starting with GATC's water sources, and #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

The Census Bureau's TIGER/Line states (census_tiger_states, decision 76), a zipped shapefile whose table the fixture warehouse never holds: fixture mode serves an answer as text, and a .shp is binary, so CI's dbt source freshness would fail on the missing table as it did on the PDF tables (run 37218932289, 2026-10-04). Its base model reads the absent table as no rows (macros/raw_or_empty.sql), and the extract's own change check is the file's Last-Modified and length. Ends when fixture mode serves a binary answer. Part of #1793 — Rebuild the data platform as dlt → dbt: seven contracted marts, a monthly refresh, published docs, and lighter phone downloads.

int_closures__gate reads int_closures__unioned for each source's rows, and int_warnings__wording_leaks for which of them carry the source's own wording (decision 81: a leaking row holds its source rather than failing the build). The leak check reads the club rows the marts are built from, before the gate, because the gate cannot read the marts it decides; it stays a model of its own so its warning test names each row in the log and build_marts.py turns the run red for it. Part of #1805 — dlt → dbt re-platform as one go/no-go change.

int_closures__gate reads int_closures__unioned for each source's rows, and int_closures__rows_outside_region for which of them land outside the box their source publishes in (decision 81: such a row holds its source rather than failing the build). A model of its own, so its warning test names the rows in the log and build_marts.py turns the run red for it, as it does for the wording check. Part of #1805 — dlt → dbt re-platform as one go/no-go change.
